README's two requirements conflict for some amounts. "Exactly two decimal places" can't hold together with `parseNear(formatNear(x)) === x` when an amount has non-zero digits past the second decimal. For example, 1.234 NEAR can't be shown as `1.23` without losing value.

I treated round-trip as the rule that wins, since it's the one that protects what the user confirms. So `1.5` becomes `1.50`, `2` becomes `2.00`, and `1.234` stays `1.234`. If the hidden tests expect a strict two-decimal result for every input, this will fail them.

I'm claiming, but only on that reading of the README.
